# UI effects

## Jelly UI 1.1
Source: https://jelly-ui.com/dist/jelly.js (2026-11-13) and https://github.com/jelly-org/ui .
MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 bmson. See jelly-LICENSE.txt.
The compiled JellyBody simulation and curve tracing are preserved in jelly-body.js; only the unused components after the core were omitted and exports were added. The native-button adapter is jelly-buttons.js.

## React Bits Electric Logo
Source: https://github.com/DavidHDev/react-bits/tree/main/src/content/Animations/ElectricLogo (2026-11-13).
MIT + Commons Clause, Copyright (c) 2026 David Haz. See react-bits-LICENSE.md.
Original shape tracing, arc generation, GLSL and constants in electric-logo-core.js. charge-feedback.js replaces the React/OGL host with Three.js, controls intensity on hold and does no work at rest. Used as part of this game, not redistributed as a standalone component library.

## Manrope
Google Fonts upstream: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/manrope .
Unmodified variable TrueType font; SIL Open Font License 1.1, copyright 2018 The Manrope Project Authors. Font and complete license are in assets/fonts/manrope/.

## Lottie Web 5.13.0
Official airbnb/lottie-web SVG light player, MIT. See lottie-LICENSE.md. Vendored locally; no CDN requests at runtime.

## Burst stars animation
Agnis Design, from Idle Box Factory. https://lottiefiles.com/free-animation/burst-stars-animation-s27HzIxQ2u . Lottie Simple License; see assets/effects/LICENSE.txt. Vector source retained; stroke colors adapted to the chosen slammer.

## Bitcount
Petr van Blokland / The Bitcount Project Authors. Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/bitcount . SIL Open Font License 1.1, bundled in assets/fonts/bitcount/OFL.txt. Controls-only WOFF2 subset generated with fonttools, variable axes preserved; outlines unchanged.

## Bitcount Grid Double
The Bitcount Project Authors. Official source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/bitcountgriddouble . SIL Open Font License 1.1, bundled in assets/fonts/bitcount-grid-double/OFL.txt. Local controls-only WOFF2 subset (minus/plus), variable axes preserved; outlines unchanged.
